facts.fact: Nation Online reports the Ministry of Agriculture, Water and Irrigation has piloted the Malawi Digital Plant Health Services project since 2022, built around the AI-powered PlantVillage app.

Nation Online reports lead farmers have used the AI PlantVillage app since 2023 to photograph crops and get written pest advisories, with data monitored by government experts through an AI observatory at the Department of Agriculture Extension Services and the Dedza district office.

The Malawi Revenue Authority's Kalondola digital excise tax stamp platform is supported by analytics and artificial intelligence to detect anomalies and flag risks, as reported by Nation Online on 22 July 2026.

facts.fact: NASA Harvest says the machine-learning GEOCIF model provides the Malawi Ministry of Agriculture with monthly maize yield forecasts that support its regular crop estimates.

The medRxiv preprint reports that ScanForm, which transcribes handwritten HIV testing register pages with AI, reached 853 of 867 HIV testing facilities (98%) nationwide by September 2024 and captured 9,082,891 testing encounters to September 2025.

The preprint reports that ScanForm's error rate fell from 1.6% to 0.4% over 24 months, errors and deviations fell 58%, 99.8% of mandatory data elements were complete and about 94.6% of records were submitted on time.
